items.title: Javon Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 3, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I talked to Dr. Woods after we spoke the other day so we’re trying to plan a way for a visit up there, a residency or something.

ctx.x: Okay. Well I appreciate your time today. I think your stories and opinions are very valuable for us to have. And I hope things return for you and for all of us. And you need to be out there performing for yourself and for us. So I look forward to that.

Yeah I appreciate you — it would be back to come back up in that area by the school. You’ve got some good restaurants up there and you’ve got a great campus. I talked to Dr. Woods after we spoke the other day so we’re trying to plan a way for a visit up there, a residency or something. So it will be nice to get back out.
Very good. I’d be happy to assist in that.
